content_rating.notes: Completed in Google Play Console before the first internal release.

account_creation.notes: Console options chosen: Username and password (the Console says usernames include email addresses) and OAuth (OpenID Connect sign-in, when the operator enables it).

data_deletion.notes: Account > Delete account in the app (and the web app) permanently deletes the account and all its data after re-authentication and a typed confirmation. The public page explains it, also signed out. Partial data deletion (individual items) is available in the app.

data_safety.notes: Optional, operator-configured Sentry error reporting in every build. Sent only through the user's own Stricknani server (never straight to Sentry), only over HTTPS (silently skipped for a plain-HTTP server URL), only when the server offers it and the user has not turned Send error reports off. Errors only, no tokens or PII. Console form must match; set completed_in_play_console to true once it does.
